assumptions: canonical long words begin with MAGIC=11100101
prefix length n is at least 8 in the successor search

construction.base_case: at U3, every inherited U2 row is below 4 and every new cross-band complement row is an old-half row below 4
construction.canonical_claim: for n>=8, the first prefix bit is the first MAGIC bit 1, hence every canonical n-bit prefix lies in HIGH_n
construction.inductive_claim: for every n>=3, Rows(U_n) is contained in [0,2^(n-1)) because U_n inherits U_(n-1) in the old-old quadrant and adds complement only for old rows against fresh columns
construction.scope_note: the collision search begins after U17; the stronger old-row containment starts at n=3, while the frozen candidate only claims the needed n>=17 consequence

falsifiers: a U3 complement edge has row >= 4
a recursive complement clause creates support with row >= 2^(n-1)
a canonical MAGIC word has leading bit 0
a canonical prefix belongs to both half intervals
the source family, encoding, or coordinate embedding differs from the frozen identities
non_guarantees: no cover or circuit lower bound

statement.canonical_prefix_projection: every length-2n canonical MAGIC word has n-bit prefix in [2^(n-1), 2^n)
statement.collision_consequence: there is no finite canonical UNSAT prefix-row collision level in the frozen one-sided family
statement.conclusion: Rows(U_n) is disjoint from the set of canonical MAGIC n-bit prefixes

transfer_conditions: support-producing quadrants remain old-old and old-new only
row indices are inherited without relabelling
the target property is row-projection collision
